hook.text: Today, we're diving into one of your most powerful tools for keyword research, the keyword overview section in Moz's Keyword Explorer. In just a few minutes, I'll show you how to uncover golden insights about any keyword you're targeting.
hook.technique_other: agenda/benefit promise read over a static branded title card ('Find Keywords Fast!') with an animated 'Voiced by AI' waveform badge

cta.text: Learn more on the Moz Help Hub at moz.com/help; get started with the freemium Keyword Explorer or sign up for a free trial; subscribe for more SEO tips.

summary.tone: Friendly, upbeat how-to tutorial with an AI-generated voice. Second-person and instructional, with casual 'gold' metaphors ('golden insights', 'two gold mines', 'pure gold'). The flat-illustrated brand cards bookend a plain product walkthrough.

signature_moments.description: Throughout the long walkthrough, the camera zooms in on each UI element as the VO names it. An orange outline draws on around the target, and a small illustrated sticker pops beside it (calendar for Monthly Volume, a character for Difficulty, a gem for the 'two gold mines').
signature_moments.why_premium: Tying camera moves and highlights to the spoken words turns a raw screen capture into a guided demo. The viewer always knows where to look, and the stickers add brand personality without hiding the real UI.

signature_moments.description: Every section change uses the same layered wipe of staggered full-height brand-colour panels: title to demo, demo to end card, and the free-tool page to the subscribe card.
signature_moments.why_premium: One repeated, on-brand transition makes the separate pieces feel like a designed system instead of spliced clips. It is cheap to build but reads as deliberate.

signature_moments.description: On the opening title card, a purple audio-waveform badge with a robot mascot animates with the voice-over and openly labels the narration 'Voiced by AI'.
signature_moments.why_premium: It gives a static card live motion that follows the audio, and it is open about the AI voice instead of hiding it.

hook.evidence: The opening is a generic 'Today we're diving into...' agenda line over a static title card that holds for 10.8 s. There is no stat, question, pain point or early product shot, and the UI first appears only at about 11.8 s.

clarity.evidence: The walkthrough is linear and step by step: navigate, type a keyword, Analyze, then each metric, suggestions, SERP analysis and a pro tip. Zoom-ins and orange highlight boxes land on each element as the VO names it, and the example query stays the same throughout.

ui_showcase.evidence: It uses the real product UI in a framed inset card, with eased camera zooms, highlight boxes and a cursor-driven expand of the AI Overview preview. However, the UI is shown as a raw capture with no recreated or simplified panels, the free-tool segment is just a static hold and a plain scroll, and dense table text is unreadable at frame size.

motion_polish.evidence: The panel wipes are clean and consistent, but most of the video is either static cards (s001, s005 and s008 hold for 10.8 s, 10.4 s and about 9.5 s) or a continuous screen capture with basic zooms and a plain scroll. There is no kinetic type, layered element animation or spring motion.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors plus visuals. A music bed at about 117 BPM is detected, and integrated loudness is -17.89 LUFS. All 10 SFX candidates (x001-x010) fall in the last 11 s (114.3-121.6 s, the s007/s008 outro), and most are labelled unsure or music, so the demo clicks, zooms and highlight pops appear to have no sound effects synced to them.

vo_script_quality.evidence: The AI-voiced script is clear, concise and well paced to the actions, with good second-person instructions and a pro tip. It leans on clichés ('golden insights', 'gold mines', 'pure gold'), and the transcript repeats 'strategy.' (w82-w83), which could be a voice artifact.

brand_consistency.evidence: The opening and both end cards share the same flat style: blue blob, yellow arc, MOZ wordmark, slab-serif type and ornaments. Every transition is a brand-blue panel wipe, and every UI shot sits in the same rounded card on the purple-to-blue gradient.

works_muted.evidence: There are no captions. Muted, a viewer sees the title, the highlighted UI elements and the end-card text, but every explanation of what a metric means and why it matters is in the VO only, and the CTA details (free tool, free trial) are spoken.

overall.evidence: A competent, well-branded product tutorial: clear guided walkthrough, consistent panel-wipe system and cards. Held back by a weak static hook, long static holds, minimal motion craft, no SFX in the demo, and full dependence on the voice-over.

localization_friendliness.notes: Card text is short and could be swapped (title, Help Hub line and URL, subscribe line), and because the narration is AI-generated, re-voicing is cheap. However, the walkthrough is an English product capture whose example query, labels and tables are baked into the recording, and the meaning depends almost entirely on the VO, with no captions.
